sentences.quote: Reckitt Benckiser Group plc (the "Company" or "Reckitt") today announces the appointment of Harry Kirsch, current CFO of Novartis Pharma AG and Deepak Nath, current CEO of Smith+Nephew plc, to the Board as Non-Executive Directors, effective 1 April 2026.
sentences.text: In March 2026 Reckitt named Harry Kirsch, Novartis CFO, and Deepak Nath, Smith+Nephew CEO, as non-executive directors from 1 April 2026, as Margherita Della Valle and Mahesh Madhavan retired from the board on the same date.
Deborah Waterhouse and Gavin Patterson joined as non-executive directors on 1 July 2026, taking seats on the audit and remuneration committees respectively.
Kris Licht remains chief executive and Shannon Eisenhardt chief financial officer.

sentences.quote: Our Fuel for Growth programme is reducing fixed costs, driving efficiency and providing us with greater capacity to invest.
sentences.text: At the July 2026 half-year results Licht cited accelerating Q2 growth and said the Fuel for Growth programme is cutting fixed costs and freeing capacity to invest, with medium-term guidance of 4-5% like-for-like growth for Core Reckitt reiterated.

citations.title: Reckitt beats its own targets and signals confidence in 2026 after year of strategic progress

sentences.text: Reckitt is now a focused health and hygiene company built around 11 high-growth, high-margin Powerbrands including Dettol, Lysol, Mucinex, Gaviscon, Nurofen, Finish and Durex, the core of the strategy it set out in July 2024.

sentences.quote: including a GBP 1.6 billion special dividend paid in February 2026, representing excess capital from the sale of Essential Home to Advent International for GBP 2.2 billion, which completed on 31 December 2025. The company retains a 30% equity stake
sentences.text: The GBP 2.2 billion sale of Essential Home to Advent International completed on 31 December 2025, with Reckitt keeping a 30% stake and funding a GBP 1.6 billion special dividend.
Capital returns are substantial, with GBP 2.3 billion returned in 2025 and a GBP 1 billion buyback running into 2026.
Growth is re-accelerating, with Core Reckitt like-for-like revenue up 4.2% in Q2 2026 and Emerging Markets up 9.4%.
Management guides to 4-5% Core Reckitt like-for-like growth and a 24.9-25.6% adjusted operating margin for 2026.
